messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: ResolverLatencyHigh in us-east-2 (az2b) — sustained DNS RTT > 400ms, 5xx rate on inference grpc up 3.2% within last 5m. Severity: P2.

emma (oncall): seeing it. pulling metrics and routes now.

jay (sre): I see gRPC stream retries from frontend -> model-backend. p95 token latency up ~350ms. Any customer-facing errors?

ana (support): support dashboard shows a handful of customers in us-east experiencing increased 502s on text-generation calls, mostly low-volume accounts. opening quick customer notes.

lina (infra): checking resolver fleet in us-east-2a AZ. Control plane shows increased conntrack usage on a subset of hosts in az2b. possible NAT/egress queueing.

emma (oncall): running quick checks:
```
# k8s svc -> endpoints
kubectl -n inference get endpoints inference-grpc -o wide
# look for pod restarts / DNS failures
kubectl -n infra logs -l app=aws-resolver -f --tail=50
```

k8s-deploy-bot: Detected 3 x envoy healthchecks failing in us-east-2/az2b (target group). Notified.

jay (sre): I can shift some router weight away from az2b to az2a and eu-west-1 for non-low-latency tiers. Doing a small 10% shift now to validate.

emma (oncall): do it. add a slow-failover policy so we don't break sticky sessions.

jay (sre): rolled 10% -> eu-west-1 for best-effort traffic. watch logs.

lina (infra): provisioning spare ephemeral nodes in az2c for model-serving as a temporary capacity boost (cold-pool spinup). ETA ~6m for init + model load.

ricardo (pm): any customers impacted who have Dedicated capacity pinned to us-east-2? need to inform sales/CS.

ana (support): yes — two Dedicated customers in us-east-2; they see elevated latency but still within SLA for now. I'll open targeted comms and flag for escalation if errors >5%.

emma (oncall): quick customer impact estimate: 3% overall increase in 5xx across region, spike concentrated on az2b, top 3 customers account for ~60% of observed 5xx.

jay (sre): mitigation update: increased resolver replicas on affected hosts (manual restart) and turned on conservative retry/backoff on frontend for DNS timeouts. Request rate of 5xx dropped to 1.1% after initial shift.

lina (infra): ephemeral nodes are up in az2c and healthy, starting model loads with lower-priority queue. If stable, we can move more routing weight there.

emma (oncall): summary so far: cause likely a combination of resolver slowpath + host-level conntrack saturation in az2b causing gRPC backpressure. Mitigations: weight-shift to other AZ/region, restart resolver pods, spin ephemeral capacity in az2c, apply conservative retry/backoff.

jay (sre): marking as ongoing. handing off to night oncall in 30m — if metrics hold (5xx <1.5% and latency trending down) we will de-escalate.

emma (oncall): leaving notes for handoff. cc @ricardo for customer comm template.

ricardo (pm): drafting short PSR for affected customers: brief cause, mitigations, ETA for full recovery (monitor 2h). Will share draft in #support.

ana (support): sent targeted messages to the two Dedicated customers with current metrics and mitigation steps.

k8s-deploy-bot: Deployment event: resolver-autoscaler scaled from 4 -> 10 replicas in us-east-2 at 3432110300.

emma (oncall): last check: p95 token latency back to +80ms over baseline, 5xx ~0.9%, all key mitigations applied. keeping monitor for 2h. handing to jay (night).

jay (sre): taking handoff. if we see another spike, will cut additional weight and consider full divert for non-PII workloads.

emma (oncall): thanks — notes in the incident timeline. :white_check_mark:
